prose: Liev Dalton of Beyond Terrain joins InnerVerse to challenge germ theory, trauma dogma, symptom suppression, supplements, protocols, and the deeper healing trap hidden inside both mainstream and alternative medicine.

Liev’s background in microbiology, virology, and counseling psychology gives him a unique perspective on both camps. After years as a therapist, Liev realized many people were not set free by focusing on their trauma and symptoms. In many cases, the healing process itself had become another identity trap.
ext: Liev turns the parasite panic upside down, questioning ivermectin, deworming, parasite cleanses, and the “kill the hidden enemy” mindset. Are parasites the cause of disease, or part of the body’s attempt to remediate a problem?
